title: Add unit tests for useTodos hook
active_form: Adding unit tests for useTodos hook
description:
Write Vitest + React Testing Library tests for the useTodos custom hook. Use renderHook to test the hook in isolation. Verify that the hook initializes from localStorage, that each action function (addTodo, deleteTodo, toggleTodo, editTodo, clearCompleted, toggleAll) correctly updates the todos state, and that state changes are synced back to localStorage. Test error handling by mocking localStorage to throw — verify the hook falls back to in-memory state and surfaces the error.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 3.2, 9.1

functional: Hook initializes with empty array when localStorage is empty
Hook initializes with persisted todos when localStorage has data
addTodo adds a new todo to the state
deleteTodo removes a todo by id
editTodo updates text for a given id
toggleAll sets all complete or all incomplete
edge_cases: Invalid JSON in localStorage triggers fallback to empty array
error_handling: localStorage write failure is handled gracefully

testing_requirements.target: Each action function updates state correctly
State syncs to localStorage after each action
